summary: S2 (eps 39-76) adapts 174-259 in order except for two knots: the Sei-childhood flashback (chs 74-82, skipped by S1) grafted into eps 44-48 while the mainline holds at 185, and the post-Sanyou threads (250-261) interleaved across eps 75-77; ep77 ends at 261 p.14 (existing anchor stands). S5 (eps 130-142) adapts 441 (p.12) through 489 - every episode has fandom page splits corroborated by an independent Japanese per-chapter table (programming-cafe) and by episode titles that equal chapter titles; ep142 ends exactly at 489 (title = ch489), so the flag-#814 value '~490' is the continue point, not the end. S6 (eps 143-155) adapts 490-540, ~4 chapters per episode, ending mid-540 with the Ryouyou (Yo Tan Wa/Heki) pages of 538-540 left for Part 2, which AniList lists as a separate entry (204688). Three fandom infobox lines are wrong or elliptical (ep39 '179', ep130 omitting 442-443, ep141 omitting 482-483) and were corrected via pcafe + title matches. 64 anchors, no type corrections, no repairs.

anchors.note: S2 opener: Shin as 300-man commander, Shun Pei Kun kidnapping teaser (ch 174). Fandom infobox literally says 'Chapter 179' (error; 179 is ep41's banquet chapter) - deduced from ep40 = 175-177 (fandom + pcafe) and the S2 start at 174 in fandom Season_2 / pcafe / subculview.

Rin Ko vs Ou Hon; Hi Shin enters; Gen Pou's smoke-screen tactics (205-207).
Hi Shin's counterattack through Gen Pou's traps (208-210).
Kyou En's mobile army; Kan Ki kills Gen Pou (211-213). 213 (Mou Ten's proposal) finishes in ep60 - ep60's title = ch213.

Ou Sen uses Heki as bait; Shin/Ou Hon wound Rin Ko and retreat. Ep title 越えるべき壁 ~ ch219 越える; pcafe gives 220 to ep63.

Wei's retreat, rewards, Kyou Kai's farewell (240-242 見送り).
Rewards at the palace; Hi Shin's losing streak; Ka Ryo Ten arrives as strategist; ep title 軍師の到着 = ch245.
Ten's gender revealed to Shin; her first plan; ep title 試練と覚悟 ~ ch246 貂の覚悟.

Qin army line-up and march (498-501).
Ri Boku reads Qin's plan; the mountain army reaches Retsubi; ep title 趙の国門 = ch504.
Retsubi siege by the mountain tribes; Jin and Tan (507); ep title 列尾攻城戦 ~ ch506 山の民の攻城戦.
Retsubi's trap, Gyou's true nature (511-513); ep title 列尾の罠 = ch511.
Ou Sen's refugee strategy; ep title 陥落の武器 = ch516.
Ryouyou and Shukai plains open; Ma Kou's attack; ep title 火蓋を切る = ch520.
Left-wing despair, Ou Hon's right wing; ep title 覚悟の比重 = ch524.
Ryouyou: Rozo's Quanrong and Yo Tan Wa; ep title 犬戎の末裔 = ch528.
Shin's detached force; ep title 必殺の別働隊 ~ ch530 必殺の別動隊.
